response.sql: SELECT s.insurstat AS insurstat, COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS site_count, 1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref)) OVER () AS share FROM scanconservation c JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.insurstat

assumptions.assumption: A missing status means a NULL insurstat. NULL rows form their own group and appear as a NULL status. Empty strings, if any, would be a separate group.

Each site has exactly one insurstat, so the sum of the per-status distinct counts equals the total number of distinct sites with conservation records. The share is therefore each count divided by that total, left unrounded.
